{{recipe}}

'''Roasted African pear''', also known as '''mzembe u mgban''' by the Tiv people of Nigeria, is a snack eaten with roasted corn.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:African Pear|African pear]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Pepper, blended
*[[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Cut pear into desired shape and size. Rinse the pieces off.
#Season the fruit with pepper, salt, and sugar.
#[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the seasoned fruit, stirring at intervals until tender.
